scope: Seven candidates for standard native-fit preparation identified by the cheap shallow screen. These are not active V3 probability jobs or scientifically admitted integrations.

entries.photometry: native SAP required; PSF_FLAT discovery retained as separate provenance
remaining: Refresh exact-signal literature and catalogue ownership.
Authenticate source-quarter native photons and actual apertures.
Review full native event membership, masks, timing/alias alternatives and any siblings.
Prepare and jointly fit period and epoch under adopted V3 with justified stellar/noise priors and measured preparation transfer.
Close complete physical stellar scene and response, then use the existing fixed-budget probability allocation.
